title: Orthonormal frames of the same subspace have the same simple n-vector up to sign
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and τ, τ' : Fin n → ℝ^P be orthonormal families with span(range τ) = span(range τ'). Then simpleNVector τ' = simpleNVector τ or simpleNVector τ' = −simpleNVector τ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (τ τ' : Fin n → Eucl P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → Orthonormal ℝ τ' → Submodule.span ℝ (range τ) = Submodule.span ℝ (range τ') → simpleNVector τ' = simpleNVector τ ∨ simpleNVector τ' = -simpleNVector τ
